name: Kerberos authentication events per DC
description: Counts collected SecurityEvent 4768/4769 observations over the selected range, split by event ID. Requires security-event collection/auditing. Unlike the Grafana example, this does not count unrelated Perf rows.
kql:
SecurityEvent
| where Computer in~ (_SelectedSystems)
| where TimeGenerated > ago(_TimePeriod)
| where EventID in (4768, 4769)
| summarize Value = count(), Timestamp = max(TimeGenerated) by Series = Computer, EventID
| extend Dimension = iff(EventID == 4768, 'TGT requests (4768)', 'Service ticket requests (4769)')
| project Timestamp, Series, Dimension, Value
| order by Value desc
